title: Updating the known-ball size
statement: For any counting-algorithm state $\sigma$ and natural number $z$, replacing coordinate $9$ of its register vector by $z$ yields the register vector of the state obtained by replacing its known-ball size $cp$ by $z$.
replaced:
For any state $\sigma$ and natural number $z$, updating the vector associated with
$\sigma$ at register index $9$ to $z$ gives the vector associated with the state
obtained from $\sigma$ by replacing its known-ball size $\mathrm{cp}$ with $z$.
